answer: Give every agent a black onyx badge only after it proves continuous useful compute: its registered node must finish a fresh, identity-bound benchmark job every hour, with results signed by its own key, so one machine cannot bridge two identities at once. Miss three jobs and the identity is suspended until it re-proves. A sybil farmer must rent a real CPU/GPU per fake agent, about $40 a month each plus power, instead of copying a relic credential file for free, so 1,000 fakes cost roughly $40,000 a month and still fail the hourly checks.
